resolutions.rationale: Option-a more fully identifies the relevant burdens: Goff leaves unknown intrinsic nature open at events 806–821, relies on antecedent panpsychism at 2555–2582, and grants only a possible answer to this cosmic example at 3404–3421. These are separate move-level limitations across the three routes, not a distinct additional debate-wide consequence.

Option-a accurately spans Folley's sample-size objection at events 743–768, public-model distinction at 2512–2528, and fixed-initial-structure reply at 3277–3299. Restricting the eligibility account to the cosmic exchange omits the other named critical burdens; none of these moves supplies an additional consequence outside its own burden and response treatment.
